AuthNull Release Notes: Week of January 01, 2024

Posted Jan 10, 2024 Updated Aug 12, 2024
By Asif Ali 1 min read

Release notes for the week of January 01, 2023

This release is moving significantly towards the vision of frictionless experience that we are trying to provide to customers.

Tenant Config

A global tenant configuration screen enables tenants to configure AuthNull - SSO, MFA, policy mode and so forth affecting the entire tenant.

Automated Policy Discovery for Frictionless Privileged Access

Automated policy discovery enables administrators to discover all authentication requests and convert them into policies. This enables frictionless onboarding of all user requests into policies without having to create policies explicitly.

Read more about Policy Discovery on the blog .

Policy Creation

The policy creation screen enables administrators to be able to create policies that allow directory users to be able to access one or more endpoints. Policies can be created to target any protocol and enable user authentication against privileged resources. Policies can additionally target specific endpoints.

Tenant level MFA settings

A global Tenant level MFA settings screen enables administrators to set MFA at various levels. Read more about it on the blog
